$comment: The performance budget every page must meet on a phone (Lighthouse's mobile preset: Moto G Power, Slow 4G, 4x CPU). Read by lighthouserc.cjs (CI: the home page and every template's sample invitation) and scripts/lighthouse-budget.mjs (a newly published invitation). Bytes are transferred (compressed) sizes of what loads with the page; fontRequests applies to the home page only (an invitation loads the fonts its host chose); serverResponseMs is the document's time to first byte.
